Liquid metal button

Motion·by @tojawuzik·2026-08-23·inspora page·original post

What it is

Liquid metal button (circular variant): a dark 'Home' pill whose circular icon is ringed by an iridescent conic-gradient halo - a lens-flare ring with RGB fringing that slowly rotates, its bright arc orbiting the circle while the dark glass body stays still.

Media

Frame-by-frame

0-100%
Black scene; pill with home glyph; the icon ring's specular arc (white core with red/cyan fringe edges) travels around the ring across frames - bottom-left -> top -> right - with soft bloom; label 'Home' static.

Build prompt

Build an iridescent-ring icon button. Pill: 160x56px, #111 face, full-round, 'Home' label 15px white next to a 36px glass circle containing a home glyph (white, 90%). The circle's rim is a 2.5px conic-gradient ring: transparent for ~280deg, then a bright white 30deg arc flanked by thin red-fringe and cyan-fringe bands (camera-lens dispersion look), all with a 6px blur duplicate behind it for bloom. Rotate the conic angle 360deg over 5s linear infinite; the bloom layer rotates in sync with 10% lag for depth. Dark scene (#050505) so the flare reads. Optional hover: orbit speed 2x and ring brightness +30%.
